Eye-contact jingle, suspicious trainers (smugglers, cultists).

Beat Imperial or cartel grunts.
Beat an arena leader: bigger victory.
Passed a Trial / beat Obi-Wan.
Crystal Caves and the Trial chambers: resonant kyber shimmer, building tension.
Won a trainer battle.
Won a wild battle: short victory loop.
Stormtroopers and cartel thugs: menacing march, works for both factions.
Boss battle against Jabba (and his lieutenants): heavy, grotesque swagger. Vader gets net:mus-vs-vader; until it lands Vader uses this too.
Final battle against Obi-Wan Kenobi: noble and climactic.
The Four Trials (Force visions of Maul, Qui-Gon, Ki-Adi-Mundi, Anakin): dreamlike, dangerous.
Grand Arena bosses (bounty hunters): gritty, mercenary.
Arena leader battle: heroic, high-stakes.
SANDO and GREATKRAYT: colossal, primal.
The Wellspring's mythical companion: playful, elusive.
The EXOGORTH: vast and cosmic.
Warden golems behind the Aurebesh vaults: mechanical, ancient.
Rival (Mira / Kael, and Luke at the end): friendly competition, energetic.
Trainer battle: driving brass and strings.
Wild companion battle: urgent orchestral action loop, the most-heard battle track.
Republic Wreck off Kashyyyk and the strange event islands (Tython Isle, Wellspring): creaking hull, eerie, drips and groans.
Storms over the worlds while SANDO and GREATKRAYT rage: dread, crashing percussion.
Hutt Hideout under Cloud City: menacing, slinking bass, gangster swagger. Fortress Vader gets its own track (net:mus-fortress-vader); until it lands both bases play this.
Prof. Korr's xenobiology lab: curious and bubbly, light synth arpeggios over pizzicato strings.
Battle Arena: gladiator pit, pounding drums.
Battle Dome bracket: crowd and fanfare.
Battle Dome lobby: tournament hype.
Battle Factory: droid foundry, mechanical rhythm.
Grand Arena grounds (Lando's battle resort): flashy, confident.
Battle Palace: calm, meditative, temple-like.
Battle Pike: twisting, uneasy.
Battle Pyramid floors: dark maze exploration.
Battle Pyramid summit: grand reveal.
Battle Tower (bounty hunter tower): tense climb.
Grand Arena lounges, lobbies and halls: smooth casino-lounge loop.
Shuttle ride up to Mustafar (the old cable car): gliding, ominous view of lava.
After a capture pod locks: short victory loop.
Cave of Evil, a dark-side vergence: unsettling, whispering pads, heartbeat pulse.
Showcase stage performance: showy, upbeat gala music.
Showcase lobby at Cloud City: glamorous gala chatter.
Showcase judging: suspense drum roll.
Showcase winner: celebratory flourish.
Credits roll: suite of the game's themes, triumphant then reflective.
Riding a hover-bike (swoop or speeder): fast repulsor-engine groove.

Bright Tree Village on Endor: Ewok treetop village, playful wooden percussion, pipes and canopy echoes.
Sabacc Den in Mos Espa: smoky alien jazz band, card-table bustle.

sw_subject: Arena interiors: determined, rhythmic build-up before a leader.
Medal ceremony on Yavin 4: triumphant and ceremonial. Original composition; do not quote film themes.
Walk into the medal hall: hushed, expectant.
Prof. Korr chased by a MASSIFF on Route 101: short urgent loop.
Opening movie: starfield, a ship drops out of hyperspace over Tatooine. Original composition; do not quote film themes.
Battle in the opening movie: short, punchy action cue.
Big sky and sea cities (Cloud City on Bespin, Tipoca City on Kamino): elegant and airy, shimmering strings, luxury with a hidden edge.
Cloud City art gallery and the Grand Arena ranking hall: refined, slow chamber strings.
Link Showcase stage, variant 1 (same piece as the Showcase, re-voiced).
Link Showcase stage, variant 2.
Link Showcase stage, variant 3.
Link Showcase stage, variant 4.

sw_subject: Dangerous places: Mustafar Peak, the Sandcrawler, the Krayt Graveyard, the Drowned Cavern, the Asteroid Spire. Ominous heat, low brass and anvil hits.
Inside Jedha Temple and other haunted interiors (Espa Generator, Wampa Cave): reverent and eerie, choral pads.
Jedha's summit where the Guardians keep the kyber: windy, haunting, holy.
Mos Eisley spacer museum: wonder at old starships, gentle synth.
Small frontier settlements (Tosche Station on Tatooine, Pirin on Sullust): relaxed, friendly, a little dusty.
Mos Entha, Dad's arena town: steady and proud with a light military snare (Doran is an ex-Republic veteran).
Jundland Wastes and other canyons and tunnels: tense and echoing, low strings and distant original horn calls.
Bacta Center tended by 2-1B: calm, healing, soft bubbling bacta tanks.
Supply depot: easygoing shop loop.
The EXOGORTH descends from the asteroid field and calms the titans: awe, huge low choir.
Sabacc table minigame: short looping jazz vamp.
First desert routes out of Mos Pelgo: open and adventurous walking theme, brass melody over heat-shimmer pads.
Breezy coast and island routes (Tatooine's Route 104, 115-116; Kashyyyk's archipelago Routes 105-109): plucked strings and wind.
Main overland routes of Tatooine and Sullust (110-112, 114, 117), including the Boonta Eve podrace course: fast, engine-driven, energetic.
Route 113, Sullust's ash fields: soft falling-ash ambience, muted bells.
Route 118, the crossing from Tatooine to Endor: starts dry and opens into forest colour.
Endor's Route 119 and the open seas of Dagobah and Kamino (129-134): lush, wandering, huge scale.
Long travel routes across Endor, Yavin 4 and Dagobah (120-128): hopeful and sweeping.
Routes 122-123 to Jedha: mystic pilgrim road, original chant-like line.
Big settlements (Bestine, Mos Espa, the Yavin 4 base) and houses along the routes: bustling marketplace percussion, bright brass, droids and traders.
Felucia Reserve: alien fungal jungle, colourful and bouncy.
The STAR TIDAL starliner: cruising through space, calm wonder.
Bestine flight academy classroom: bright, studious.
Ancient vaults (Tusken Ruins, Ancient Tomb, Island Cave, Sealed Vault) with Aurebesh puzzles: eerie and sparse.
Mos Eisley spaceport: shady and swaggering, jazzy alien-band colour, ships coming and going.
Dagobah: misty swamp, mysterious and wise; woodwinds, soft bells, insects.
Riding a companion across water: buoyant travel theme. If Tatooine water becomes the Dune Sea, give it a sand-skimming colour.
Title screen: big orchestral main title with a heroic brass call. Original composition; do not quote film themes.
Garindan's Trick House: sneaky and comic.
Diving (Dagobah's underwater routes, Drowned Cavern): muffled, slow, floating.
Anchorhead: sleepy moisture-farm town, gentle and pastoral.

Fortress Vader (Mustafar): Imperial menace, cold march, heavy low brass. Split from the shared villain-hideout track so the Empire and the Cartel sound different. Original composition; do not quote film themes.
Boss battle against Darth Vader: relentless, operatic, choir hits. Split from the shared leader battle (Jabba keeps MUS_VS_JABBA). Original composition; do not quote film themes.
Boba Fett's bounty-hunt boss battles: cold, percussive, western-tinged.
Death Star construction site (post-game): vast, mechanical, oppressive.
Hyperspace trips between planets on the Falcon or a shuttle: rush into hyperspace, then a soaring travel theme.
Blaster bolt: the classic pew, for BLASTER SHOT and stormtrooper scenes.
Lightsaber ignition snap-hiss: SABER SLASH wind-up and cutscenes where Vader, Obi-Wan or Luke draw a saber.
Lightsaber swing whoosh with hum: SABER SLASH hit.
Two blades meeting: crackling clash, for duels in cutscenes (Vader vs Obi-Wan visions).
Idle lightsaber hum loop for overworld cutscenes.
Force push: low air-pressure thump and rush. Replaces the sound in Move_PSYCHIC (FORCE PUSH) only.
Force choke: tight, strained hum. FORCE CHOKE only.
Force lightning crackle for FORCE BOLT (Shock Wave).
Turbolaser: heavy capital-ship cannon shot for TURBOLASER (Hyper Beam). SE_M_HYPER_BEAM stays for Thunderbolt.
Ion cannon: charged electric blast for ION CANNON (Zap Cannon).
Vibroblade: buzzing blade slice for VIBROBLADE (Cut), battle and field.
Slicer spike plugged into a droid: data scramble and a success chirp (droid slicing).
Jump to hyperspace: rising whine then boom, for planet-to-planet travel.
Astromech beeps and whistles for droid NPCs (2-1B, QUIZ DROIDS, R1 UNIT) when they talk.
Imperial base alarm klaxon: Fortress Vader, the Launch Tower raid, the Death Star site.
Vader's respirator: plays as he enters a scene.
TIE fighter scream flyby for Imperial raid cutscenes (Launch Tower, Endor Station).
